plugins.name: supermatt
plugins.description: The best of Matt Pocock's Skills, Superpowers, and Compound Engineering. One complete, simple, supercharged SDLC system for your coding agent.

skills.name: architecture-review
skills.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
headings: 3. Present candidates as an HTML report
skills.description_zh: 扫描代码库中可进一步改善设计的机会，生成可视化 HTML 报告，并深入讨论用户选中的方案。

skills.name: ask-supermatt
skills.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.
skills.description_zh: 根据用户情况，在该仓库的技能和流程之间选择合适入口。

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along three axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?), Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?), and Adversarial (how does the change fail in production?). Runs the reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side with a verdict. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, deepen a chosen module, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
headings: Ways to construct one, in roughly this order
When you genuinely cannot build a loop
Completion criterion: a tight loop that goes red
Completion criterion: a causal chain with no gaps
skills.description_zh: 对难定位的缺陷或性能退化开展循环诊断，分析报错、失败和运行缓慢等问题。

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when pinning down domain terms or a ubiquitous language, resolving a vague or overloaded word, stress-testing how domain concepts relate, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or recording a hard-to-reverse architectural decision as an ADR.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
skills.description_zh: 通过持续深入提问，澄清和完善计划或设计。

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADRs and glossary) as we go.

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, says "grill me", or asks to poke holes in, challenge, or be interviewed about a plan or design, even without the word "grill".

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Write the current conversation into a portable handoff document for another agent to pick up.

skills.name: ideate
skills.description: Generate grounded ideas for what to build next, critique every one, and rank the survivors in a Markdown file.

skills.name: implement
skills.description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec, tickets, or triaged issues.

skills.name: pr
skills.description: The shape of a pull request body: a summary diagram, before/after evidence, and merge danger. Use when opening a PR, writing or rewriting a PR description, or when another flow needs a PR body.

skills.name: prototype
skills.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
skills.description_zh: 构建可丢弃的原型，验证状态模型、逻辑或界面设计是否符合预期。

skills.name: qa
skills.description: QA a change in the running program, the way its user meets it: drive a CLI or terminal UI through tmux, a web app through a browser, and check every requested behavior against what you observe. Use after implementing a change and before code review, or when the user asks for a QA pass, a smoke test, or a click-through of a change, or asks whether it actually works.
headings: 1. Pin the change and the request

skills.name: research
skills.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.
skills.description_zh: 依据可信一手资料研究问题，核对文档及 API 事实，并将发现保存为仓库中的 Markdown 文件。

skills.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
skills.description: Resolves an in-progress git merge or rebase conflict by tracing why each side changed, reconciling every conflicted hunk, running the project's checks, and finishing the merge or rebase. Use when a merge, rebase, or pull stops on conflicts, when files contain conflict markers, or when the user asks to fix or resolve merge conflicts.

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Conduct a retrospective on a coding session.
skills.description_zh: 对一次编码会话进行复盘。

skills.name: setup-supermatt-skills
skills.description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.
skills.description_zh: 首次使用工程技能前配置仓库的议题跟踪系统、分类标签词汇及领域文档布局。

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
skills.description_zh: 采用测试驱动开发实现功能或修复缺陷，通过红灯、绿灯、重构步骤推进，也用于集成测试。

skills.name: teach
skills.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
skills.description_zh: 在当前工作区内教授用户新的技能或概念。

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.
headings: What load is the system expected to handle at launch?
skills.description_zh: 将尚无法完整回答的决策问题整理为供其他人填写的问卷。

skills.name: to-spec
skills.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.
skills.description_zh: 直接综合当前会话中已讨论的信息形成规格，并发布到项目议题跟踪系统。

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).
headings: 5. Publish the tickets to the configured tracker
skills.description_zh: 将计划、规格或当前讨论拆成可逐步验证端到端路径的工单，声明阻塞依赖，并以本地文件或跟踪系统原生关系记录。

skills.name: triage
skills.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.
headings: Triage a specific issue or PR
skills.description_zh: 按分类角色状态机处理议题与外部 PR，完成分类、核验和必要的深入询问，形成可供代理执行的简报。

skills.name: wait-what
skills.description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.
skills.description_zh: 重新组织上一条未能有效传达的消息，使表达更贴合接收者。

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.description: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.
skills.description_zh: 将超出单次代理会话容量的大型工作规划为议题系统中的共享决策地图，逐一解决决策工单以明确实施路径。

skills.name: wizard
skills.description: Deprecated. SuperMatt 0.7.0 removes this skill, with no replacement.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, or writing any doc an agent reaches by a pointer.

headings: Skills hand off to each other
